The '''Soft Landings Inn''' was located on [[Quarter Moon Street]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
The inn was made entirely from salvaged materials. [[Durasteel/Legends|Durasteel]] sheets and conductor pipes wrapped around it, and the entire building, which had at least three levels, leaned to one side. It provided minimal comfort and was only really for travelers to get a few hours of sleep. Security was extremely lax at the inn, and anyone could book a room as long as they had the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to pay for it.

In [[43 BBY/Legends|43 BBY]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], came to the inn looking for the infamous [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Ona Nobis]]. After a brief battle, Nobis escaped using her natural [[Sorrusian]] abilities.
